Hi all,
I just noticed a tricky behavior that goes back to the ftwindow function:
If the argument to wn is misstyped, eg "haning" instead of "hanning", then the function gives no warning, but defaults silently to "hamming".
Could this get fixed by checking if the input is part of an allowed list?

All the best
Iris
